schema.description: A schema card for a table or dataset, holding schema_col children as its column list.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The table or dataset name, shown in monospace.

col.description: One column row: a monospace name, a muted type tag, an optional primary-key marker, and an optional note.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The column name, shown in monospace.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The column type, shown as a muted tag.

attributes.name: pk
attributes.description: Marks the column as a primary key. Normally written bare.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: A short muted note at the end of the row.

pipeline.description: A horizontal flow of schema_stage children with arrows between them, wrapping on narrow width.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: A small heading above the flow.

attributes.name: min-width
attributes.description: Default width floor for every stage in the flow, as a px, rem, em, or ch length.

stage.description: One pipeline stage chip: a label, with an optional technology line under it.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The stage label, for when bracket content is not used.

attributes.name: tech
attributes.description: The technology, in smaller monospace under the label.

attributes.name: min-width
attributes.description: Width floor for this chip, as a px, rem, em, or ch length. Wins over the flow default.

fact.description: A static figure worth remembering, shown large above its caption. Not data-bound.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The figure, shown large in monospace.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The caption, for when bracket content is not used.
